kultivator.sectbuild.skip.done_rules: Part skipped; its unused materials went back to the Storehouse. A skipped part does NOT count as finished: its tier stays incomplete, so the hall's building cap and buildings do not rise. To build it later: /kultivasi aula bangun prioritas <part>.
kultivator.sectbuild.skip.not_allowed: Only a part that is blocked or waiting for materials can be skipped.
kultivator.sectbuild.prio.requeued: The skipped part is queued again and comes first in its tier; its tier counts once it is built.
kultivator.sectbuild.lumbung.to_peti: The Sect Granary is full: %s and the rest went to the Dig Chest (Materials panel).
kultivator.sectbuild.lumbung.pending: The Sect Granary and the Dig Chest are full: %s is waiting (%s stacks in all). Take goods out of the Granary or the Dig Chest; the waiting goods move in by themselves.
kultivator.sectbuild.lumbung.still_pendi: %s stacks of sect goods are still waiting for room in the Sect Granary or the Dig Chest.
kultivator.sectbuild.lumbung.delivered: %s waiting stacks of sect goods moved into the Granary or the Dig Chest (%s still waiting).
